name: omnisense/omnipulse
description: Omnipulse: what outside platforms know of a site or a project, under any PHP host - its audience (search queries, pages and positions from the search engines, Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools; visitors, entry pages and sources from the analytics tools, Matomo, Plausible and Google Analytics 4: one query and one report whoever answers), its reviews (an establishment's rating and reviews, replying, inviting a customer, the link to leave one, on Google, Tripadvisor and Trustpilot, each platform's terms of display and caching declared) and its funding (the profile, sponsors and tiers on GitHub Sponsors, Open Collective and Liberapay). One Registry, contracts by capability; providers are packages of their own (omnipulse/<provider>); a Symfony bundle and Twig functions for the reviews in Bridge/, the other hosts' wiring in omnibridge.

suggest.omnipulse/bing-webmaster: Bing Webmaster Tools: queries, pages, clicks, impressions, positions
suggest.omnipulse/ga4: Google Analytics 4 (Data API): visitors, sessions, landing pages, sources
suggest.omnipulse/github-sponsors: GitHub Sponsors: the listing, its goal and tiers, the public sponsors (GraphQL, a token)
suggest.omnipulse/google-reviews: Google reviews: Places API (rating, reviews) and Business Profile API (all reviews, replying, for the owner)
suggest.omnipulse/liberapay: Liberapay: the public profile - patrons counted, weekly income, goal (public.json, no key)
suggest.omnipulse/matomo: Matomo (Reporting API, self-hosted or cloud): visits, entry pages, referrers, countries
suggest.omnipulse/opencollective: Open Collective: the collective, its tiers and stats, its backers (GraphQL v2, public data without a key)
suggest.omnipulse/plausible: Plausible (Stats API v2, cloud or self-hosted): visitors, entry pages, sources
suggest.omnipulse/search-console: Google Search Console: queries, pages, countries, devices, clicks, impressions, CTR, positions
suggest.omnipulse/tripadvisor: Tripadvisor Content API: rating, reviews, the link to write one
suggest.omnipulse/trustpilot: Trustpilot: TrustScore, reviews, replies and invitations
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire a family into their host
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnipulse\Bridge\Symfony\OmnipulseBundle (with symfony/config and symfony/dependency-injection)
suggest.twig/twig: With Twig: Omnipulse\Bridge\Twig\OmnipulseExtension, omnipulse_reviews_widget() and the others
suggest.symfony/cache-contracts: With Twig: the reviews shown kept in a cache, within each platform's terms
